## Kubernetes

Due to CEL, prometheus-operator >= v0.84.0 requires Kubernetes >= v1.25.0 (or v1.23.0 with the `CustomResourceValidationExpressions` feature gate enabled).

Releases before v0.84.0 require Kubernetes >= v1.16.0.

## Prometheus

Prometheus Operator supports all Prometheus versions >= v2.0.0.

## Alertmanager

The Prometheus Operator is compatible with Alertmanager v0.15 and above.
